steps.name: Innkeeper
steps.text: Who was that man? He just came in, looked around, and left.

steps.name: Inn Assistant
steps.text: Could be a plainclothes from the Patrol Battalion, coming to see if there are smugglers here?

steps.name: Innkeeper
steps.text: Plainclothes won't bumble like that or draw so much attention.

steps.name: Inn Assistant
steps.text: Then he came to cause trouble. I'll go and catch him.

steps.name: Innkeeper
steps.text: How? He was gone in the blink of an eye. He clearly knows qinggong.

steps.name: Burly Man
steps.text: That was the last inn. Nothing.

steps.name: Burly Man
steps.text: The girl said she wanted to leave the city, but she's not at the gates.

steps.name: Burly Man
steps.text: The doc had to use the best meds to treat her. What if she doesn't come back, and he puts the bill on my tab?

steps.name: Burly Man
steps.text: I have to catch her.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: I'm not sure I understand your analogy.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Ah, it wasn't the most apt.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: I opened my little agency in Lungmen to make a living, but business ended up better than I expected.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Wei Yenwu and the L.G.D. can't deal with every little trouble out there.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: We need good citizens like Mr. Lin to pitch in.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: It can't be helped.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Can't be helped... that's true for Lungmen, and it's true for Yumen as well.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Yumen patrols the northern borders to repel potential threats to Yan.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Back when Originium technology was not so advanced, it took several times the manpower to run a mobile fortress like Yumen, compared to today.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: A group of patriotic martial artists went to Yumen at the time. They never officially joined the army, but they helped out with all sorts of things.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Escorting Messengers, scouting the path ahead, even going into battle with the army... they played a key role in Yumen's peace and prosperity, and earned the respect of the city.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: The court and jianghu were of one mind.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: This was how Yumen used to be... until twenty years ago.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: The Shanhaizhong?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Yes. Once again, the Shanhaizhong were the reason.

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: There's nothing else.

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: I hope I didn't bother you in your duties. It would be on my head.

steps.name: Zuo Xuanliao
steps.text: You knew I wouldn't agree.
A short whistle, then the tower's Originium lighting shuts off without warning, surrounding the pair in darkness.
A flickering flame lights up in the distance a second later.
The soldiers run back and forth, passing the torch between the beacons.
Seventeen roars of the drum, dragged through the night sky by the rapidly moving Yumen.

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: Today is the second day of the Wangfeng Festival.

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: It was created to remind the people of Yumen to remember the past.

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: This meeting may have taken place earlier, or later.

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: By then, you may have recalled a few things.

steps.name: Zuo Xuanliao
steps.text: I've never forgotten.

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: Do you remember how many of the heroes who died for Yumen were not soldiers?

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: They owe Yumen nothing.

steps.name: Zuo Xuanliao
steps.text: Nor does Yumen owe anyone anything.

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: Zuo!

steps.name: Zuo Xuanliao
steps.text: Stand down.

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: It was my negligence that allowed those criminals into the city twenty years ago, disguised as Yumen martial artists. You can blame me, punish me, execute me!

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: But the blame should fall only on me—or on you!

steps.name: Zuo Xuanliao
steps.text: All the responsibility falls upon me.

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: And how have you taken responsibility? Alienating the brothers who gave blood and sweat for Yumen, driving them away—is that your idea of taking responsibility?

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: Yumen owes them an answer!

steps.name: Zuo Xuanliao
steps.text: Yumen belongs to Yan. All it does is in the service of the Yanese people. That's my answer.

steps.name: Zuo Xuanliao
steps.text: This meeting is over.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: The name 'Shanhaizhong' is not widely known.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: It wasn't that anyone was negligent. Everyone was so focused on guarding against external threats, they didn't realize there were enemies hiding in the shadows.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Bodyguards, bouncers, blacksmiths... these civilians often fought alongside the soldiers, and enjoyed a great deal of freedom in Yumen. The Shanhaizhong took advantage of this fact.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: The city was caught off-guard and responded slowly. The Shanhaizhong's plot to destroy the city's power core was foiled, but only after heavy casualties had been taken.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: After that...

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Taking measures after the fact is still better than not at all.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: But the measures might have gone too far.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: After that, the Lord Exorcist began to reform the city's administration, removing jianghu involvement, and setting increased restrictions on the movement of people.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Some of those who stayed joined the army. Others put their swords down and took up another living. An ordinary cook at an inn may have been a famous swordsman, back in the day.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Twenty years is plenty of time for a city to look very different.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Dad always says that there will come a day when Lungmen won't need downtown or the Rat King anymore.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: If there comes a day when this city no longer needs to patrol the barrenlands, then the people in the city won't need to carry swords anymore.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Times change. Some want to give it a push, others a pull. In the end, they're all left behind.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: That's the story that I heard. Does it help?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: A lot, actually.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Thank you, Mr. Lee.

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: What did you learn?

steps.name: Yumen Martial Artist
steps.text: Ten-man, two-hour shifts. No extra guards at the sand sluice.

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: Just as I saw.

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: One more thing to ask you to do.

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: At the Hour of Yu, I want you to cause a little commotion around the sand sluice.

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: Nothing too big, just draw away the patrols.

steps.name: Yumen Martial Artist
steps.text: What do you...?

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: Ask no questions, if you still trust me.

steps.name: Yumen Martial Artist
steps.text: ...Alright.

steps.name: Yumen Martial Artist
steps.text: Did you see Zuo Xuanliao on the tower?

steps.name: Meng Tieyi
steps.text: Yes, I did.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: It's getting hotter...

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Someone attacked Wei Yenwu last night and threw the Yumen barracks into chaos. You were the assassin.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: You cause abnormal weather wherever you go. Is this Arts? Or some other trick?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Murder of a Messenger, attempted theft of Catastrophe data, attempted assassination of a court official.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: What do you think Yumen is, Shanhaizhong?!

steps.name: Shanhaizhong Boss
steps.text: A city headed the wrong way.

steps.name: Shanhaizhong Boss
steps.text: This way is wrong. Go no further.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: You know why Yumen is returning...

steps.name: Shanhaizhong Boss
steps.text: It's not hard to guess.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Father tasked me to complete three tasks in three days: recover the Grandmaster's sword, catch the assassin, and track down the Shanhaizhong who have infiltrated the city.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: It turns out all the answers were right here in the Sword Forge.

steps.name: Shanhaizhong Boss
steps.text: You won't complete any of them.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Stand back. This one's kung fu is unfathomable. We're no match for him.

steps.name: Shanhaizhong Boss
steps.text: You're not as strong as the Forte man, but you seem a little quicker on the uptake.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: So it was you who attacked Lord Taihe.

steps.name: Shanhaizhong Boss
steps.text: You dodged the last strike. Will you dodge or block the next one?
Neither.
He often told her that kung fu is like climbing a mountain, whether as a tool of revenge, or a way of life. The more treacherous the path, the steadier one's heart must be.
She saw her enemy, and she saw the mountain. That is why she spent five years with him.
If the battle cannot be won, she would seek to not lose.

steps.name: Shanhaizhong Boss
steps.text: Offense is the best defense?

steps.name: Shanhaizhong Boss
steps.text: You have guts, I'll give you that...

steps.name: Shanhaizhong Boss
steps.text: But things are not as simple as you think.
They cross swords, and she realizes her decision was imprudent.
She is facing another mountain.
Cold steel flashes before her face, the droplets on the blade touching her nose. She can hear her own heartbeat.
If the Record Keeper was here, he would have exclaimed that Qiubai recreated the move on the training ground.
Dive, stop, and turn around before hitting the arc of death, like the fowlbeast that narrowly avoids the waves on the river.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: (Groans)

steps.name: Shanhaizhong Boss
steps.text: You dodged again.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: How dare you!

steps.name: Shanhaizhong Boss
steps.text: You?

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Get out of the way, Zuo Le!
Qiubai grabs Zuo Le by the collar and pulls him back.
He sees the foe's third swing, which lights up the yard.
It is March, but the Sword Forge feels like it is mid-summer. Even the night sky looks a little whiter in the heat wave.
There is only a pagoda tree behind them. There is nowhere to run.

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: The sword.

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: Don't move!

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: You're still trying to take the sword? Do you want to get yourself killed?

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: You're not dying until you tell me where Meng Tieyi is, guawazi!
A burly man suddenly appears in the yard.
He grabs the girl and knocks away the sword in one fluid motion.
Like a bucket of cold water poured down on the ground, he forces everyone to scatter.
The heat disappears.

steps.name: Burly Man
steps.text: I've been looking for you.

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: Let me go!

steps.name: Burly Man
steps.text: You almost got yourself killed.

steps.name: Burly Man
steps.text: I told you to stay put in the clinic. Now you've made your injuries worse.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: You're still in Yumen, Huai?

steps.name: Huai
steps.text: Oh, it's you.

steps.name: Huai
steps.text: Your shifu won't fight me until he's left his post. I have to wait for him.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: You haven't budged for three years?

steps.name: Huai
steps.text: Nope.

steps.name: Huai
steps.text: What's more important than this? Where can I find an opponent like him after he leaves Yumen?

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: There's a kung fu master right here in front of you. Why don't you have a go at her if it's a fight you're looking for?

steps.name: Huai
steps.text: This woman?

steps.name: Shanhaizhong Boss
steps.text: You're in my way.

steps.name: Huai
steps.text: Something didn't feel right when I blocked that attack.

steps.name: Huai
steps.text: It was heavy, but had neither form nor design. I don't know what that strange power is, but you're no master.

steps.name: Huai
steps.text: I have no time for you.

steps.name: Wanderer
steps.text: You hear that commotion inside, Jing?

steps.name: Wanderer
steps.text: That young man just broke in before I could stop him.

steps.name: Jing
steps.text: Damn.

steps.name: Jing
steps.text: This is Tieyi's last workshop. He's been good to us. We need to protect it.

steps.name: Alert Shanhaizhong Member
steps.text: Master, Boss, there are more jianghu adventurers coming.

steps.name: Alert Shanhaizhong Member
steps.text: And Yumen soldiers behind them, coming from three directions, around a hundred in total.

steps.name: Shanhaizhong Boss
steps.text: No point wasting time here if the one we're looking for isn't here.
Sudden silence. It is as though the cicadas were never there.
It is still March. The chill of early spring makes everyone shiver.

steps.name: Shanhaizhong Ringleader
steps.text: Let's go!

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Stop right there!

steps.name: Wanderer
steps.text: That's the one, Jing!

steps.name: Jing
steps.text: Where are you going, sir?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Out of my way!

steps.name: Jing
steps.text: Look at the mess here. Hardly anything left standing except the walls. You owe us an explanation.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: This is a Yumen military case. Anyone who interferes will be arrested.

steps.name: Jing
steps.text: Wait... you're Zuo Xuanliao's kid.

steps.name: Jing
steps.text: So Zuo Xuanliao wants to take down the last Sword Forge now?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Impudence!

steps.name: Millenion
steps.text: Lord Zuo.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Did you see the Shanhaizhong on your way here?

steps.name: Millenion
steps.text: We've sent men after them.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Good. Round them up and take them into custody.

steps.name: Millenion
steps.text: Lord Zuo, there are dozens of them... all local residents...

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: They appeared right as the criminals retreated and obstructed our pursuit. They must be investigated thoroughly.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: All the rest have something to do with the case.

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: The girl in the exotic outfit was hiding in the Sword Forge. She must know where Meng Tieyi is. I'm going with you, if you take her away.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: The Sword Forge is linked to the Shanhaizhong. Given your ties to Meng Tieyi, I would have asked you to come with us regardless.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: As for you...

steps.name: Huai
steps.text: She's coming with me to get her wounds treated, and pay her bill.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: This is no time for jokes.

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: I-I can't go with you...

steps.name: Huai
steps.text: Hmph, all you care about is the sword.

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: Why you—!

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Take these people back to the barracks for questioning. I'll go after the Grandmaster's sword.

steps.name: Millenion
steps.text: Are you alright, Miss Qiu?

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Just a scratch. Do as Zuo Le says for now.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Please treat these jianghu people with proper respect, Millenion.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: That man...
Noises continue to emanate from the direction of the Sword Forge, but Waai Fu stops in her tracks.
The figure on the roof vanished in the blink of an eye, as though it was just a gust of wind.
Waai Fu tightens her fist.
She has never been more certain.
